description: Inspect Uptime Kuma v2 monitors, heartbeats, and incident context; retry changes are explicitly gated.
catalog_description: Inspect Uptime Kuma v2 monitors, heartbeats, and incident context; retry changes are explicitly gated.

novel_features.name: Incident context composite
novel_features.description: Combines monitor identity, recent heartbeat timeline, and current status into one redacted operator brief.
novel_features.rationale: No single Kuma call provides an incident-ready context packet.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reduces alert investigation from several protocol calls to one deterministic read-only command.

novel_features.name: Complete-object retry safety gate
novel_features.description: Previews and, only with explicit --yes, applies a complete monitor edit while preserving unrelated fields and verifying readback.
novel_features.rationale: Kuma editMonitor is full replacement; a narrow patch risks silently clearing settings.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Makes the dangerous replacement semantics visible and operator-gated.

novel_features.name: Socket.IO heartbeat normalization
novel_features.description: Normalizes Kuma Socket.IO heartbeat records into a bounded time-window timeline with redacted output.
novel_features.rationale: Kuma exposes management data over Socket.IO, not a conventional REST resource.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Provides an agent-friendly incident timeline without exposing credentials or raw protocol records.
